title.ur: inverter air conditioner par 88 display kharabi

meaning.en: Units show "88" on the display as a fault state; Urdu video covers solving it (generic self-diagnosis/reset class).
meaning.ur: Units kharabi ki haalat mein display par "88" dikhate hain; Urdu video is ka hal batati hai (aam khud-karam/reset class)

causes.en: Display/control self-diagnosis state after fault or power event
causes.ur: Kharabi ya power event ke baad display/control ki self-diagnosis haalat

causes.en: Underlying board fault may require service if 88 stays
causes.ur: 88 qaim rahe to andaruni board kharabi ho sakti hai

solutions.en: Power off at breaker for several minutes and restart
solutions.ur: breaker se kuch minute ke liye band karke dobara on karein
88 baqi rahe to hyir service blaiyn
